title: The ledger's pending triage file
description: A pending triage file, <ledger>/.pending/<session>/triage-<member>-<attempt>.json, holds the values a planning skill decided for one member's dispatch before the dispatch is issued. Its file name carries the member id and the attempt the brief's frontmatter names. Each value is stamped from the clock as it is written: an object holding the value and the time. The capture copies every value onto that dispatch record with its stamp, then removes the file; where the file carries `kind`, the capture runs no triage of its own and records that kind as the triage's reading. A file that does not validate against this schema gives an error line, and the dispatch record is still written. The capture reads a file only by the name the brief's member and attempt make, inside the session's pending folder, and never follows a path a file names. pending.py reads this schema; no other file defines the pending triage file. The planning skill's own dispatch has a pending file of its own, <ledger>/.pending/<session>/planner-<plan-request-id>.json, whose name is its whole content as far as the capture is concerned: the capture reads no value from it. Where the brief of a dispatch carrying no member id names that plan-request id, standing alone, the capture records the dispatch as the planner's own, naming the plan request in member and attempt, and removes the file once the record is written. A kept check result, <ledger>/.pending/<session>/check-<agent>-<n>.json, is a check's result at one stop or hand-back of that agent, numbered in the order the checks ran (`checkResult`). It names its event and may carry any other key the check writes; the capture copies it onto the call's one return as it finds it, less its own `seen` and `missing` marks, and removes it.

value.description: One of the kinds in kinds.json. A test holds this list equal to kinds.json's.

kind.description: The kind of act the planning skill read from the brief. Where present, the capture runs no triage and records it as triage_kind.

effort_unaided.description: The effort level the dispatching agent would choose unaided, stamped before any assigned level is shown to it.

decision_records.description: The planning skill's decision records for the part, one per decision.

triage_persona.description: The persona the planning skill named for the part, or the one the dispatching agent chose instead.

persona_facts.description: The facts the persona's choice rested on.

kind_paired_grouping.description: The grouping the part's kind is paired with: a fact for the choice, never the record's grouping.

chosen_by.description: Who chose the call's persona: the planning skill or the dispatching agent.

overrides.description: For each decision the dispatching agent overrode, what its decision record cannot carry.

below_line.description: The mark for a part no persona reached the adequacy line for, with the probability and the line.

triage_failure.description: That the planning skill's triage was attempted and failed, with the reason.

event.description: The harness event the check ran at: SubagentStop, or PreToolUse at a hand-back.

refused.description: Whether the check refused the stop or the hand-back.

seen.description: The capture's mark: a stop has taken this result.

missing.description: The capture's mark: a stop check was on and left no result.

disposition.description: A pending disposition file, <ledger>/.pending/<session>/disposition-<call id>.json (or -2, -3 where one already waits), written by the return check's disposition script. At the PostToolUse of the parent's next shell call the capture writes it as a disposition line and removes it.
